translation: He also said: In women, when menstrual disease and metrorrhagia last long and become withered, one should astringe and supplement it. When blood blockage lasts long and becomes exhausted, one should supplement and break it. Breaking blood has three treatments: first, Siwu [decoction] with honghua (safflower), adjusted with huangqi (Astragalus) and rougui (cinnamon).
